label: They hack the 911 emergency system as a distraction
description: A word that in the days ahead the emergency call system would be hacked and interfered with, given as practice for a larger event: when the major event comes they hack the 911 database so the distraction covers it.

label: Bibles burned in a heap in a football stadium
description: Seen: Bibles gathered into a mound five storeys high in a football stadium and burned, compared by him to the book burning scenes in an Indiana Jones film. Shown on location against a field several hundred years old.

label: A leader dies of a heart attack days after returning from Russia
description: He says he had been praying over this for several weeks and that the Lord warned about it: US Senator Lindsey Graham died of a heart attack at home in the night on 13 July 2026, within about a day of returning from a trip abroad, with Iranian accounts celebrating and saying he had been marked. He states repeatedly that he is not calling it a poisoning. The antecedent word is not located in this corpus.
